summary: A semi-automatic 7.62 marksman rifle in the SR-25 idiom: long free-floated barrel in a full-length railed tub… joints trigger, bolt, bipod, magazine; options finish, optic; sockets socket_muzzle, socket_optic, socket_foregrip, socket_rail_l, socket_rail_r, socket_magazine, ….
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.marksman_rifle or place "prefab": "marksman_rifle" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d(), viewmodel().
